Have you noticed any increasing pain with movement of the nearby leg muscles or any numbness/tingling in the area (suggesting deep infection or nerve/compartment involvement)?
Have you noticed any rapidly worsening skin pain out of proportion to the redness or any skin discoloration (e.g., gray/black mottling) over the area?
What is the patient’s current temperature (measured) and heart rate?
